Amsterdam Pop-ups: the interactive guide with map, filters and Dutch version · All this week's events

Food in Amsterdam this week

16 – 22 Nov · 16 events

Pop-up dinners, supper clubs, food markets, tastings and one-off kitchen takeovers across Amsterdam. Good for anyone who likes to try something new, from a quick street-food bite to a long shared table with strangers. The list is refreshed every week, so there is always something different to taste. Every listing is checked on the organiser's own page. Times and prices can change, so check the organiser's link before you go.

  1. Film, Food & Solidarity: Pride (2014) at QueerHub Nieuw-West

    Film · Queer · Food

    When
    Mon 16 Nov, 18:00–21:30 (meal 18:30, film 19:00)
    Where
    QueerHub Nieuw-West, Notweg 38, Amsterdam (Nieuw-West)
    Price
    Free incl. meal; register
    Organiser
    Treehouse Rootz & Shewaken

    A shared meal and a screening of Pride, about LGBTQ+ activists who backed striking miners in 1984, followed by a talk in Dutch led by Rahma el Hannoufi. Film in English.
